tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file from the workspace. Returns the file content and its byte length. Paths outside the workspace are rejected.

path.description: Relative path inside the workspace, for example docs/README.md

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the local documentation index and return the top matching sections with source anchors.

tools.name: summarize
tools.description: Summarize a text passage. The summary is generated locally with a sentence-ranking heuristic and never leaves the process.
